title: definition-list — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins one parse-recognition case for the Myne dialect definition-list construct (src/dialect/lezer/definition-list.ts, main myne repository). A case hex-decodes a markdown source and pins expected_dialect_spans: the byte ranges (UTF-8 offsets, pre-order traversal) the parser recognizes as definition-list nodes (DefinitionList, DefinitionTerm, DefinitionDesc, DefinitionMarker). A 'recognize' case carries one or more spans; an 'inert' case carries an empty span list (a near-miss the parser must NOT recognize). Not an on-disk codec and not cryptographic — deterministic cross-client parse behavior: every independent client must recognize the same byte ranges. TS-runner category (no Rust generator); the live parser is asserted by tests/dialect/dialectParse.test.ts.

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'definition-list/v0.1/<slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

case_kind.description: recognize: the construct is present (spans non-empty). inert: a near-miss that must not be recognized (spans empty).

input_markdown_utf8_hex.description: The markdown source as exact UTF-8 bytes (hex). The byte sequence is the contract, immune to JSON-tooling normalization.

informational_markdown.description: Human-readable mirror of input_markdown_utf8_hex; the runner cross-checks it byte-equal against the hex.

expected_dialect_spans.description: The recognized spans in document (pre-order) traversal order. Empty for inert cases.
